high_level_description: This image is a screenshot of an Instagram post from the account @about_environment. The post features a photograph of a hand holding a piece of white plastic, which appears to be partially eaten or broken down by wax worms. The background is slightly blurred, focusing attention on the hand and the plastic. The text overlay on the image reads: "Scientists have discovered that wax worms can eat and break down one of the most common plastics (polyethylene) into organic compounds. Wax worms are common insects and some experts say the discovery could help reduce plastic pollution.
